# Amanah Under Fire — trailer shot plan v3 (live action)

<!-- Generated by demo-run/storyboard-html.ts. Edit demo-run/storyboard.ts instead. -->

**29 sequences · 74 beats · 5m 32s of source · Fakebook**

## The spine

One woman asks one question: my child’s bursary — is it still coming? It sits on screen
unanswered while the lie machine runs and the team gets it wrong once, publicly. The film is
over when they earn the right to answer her by name.

The film opens on an ordinary afternoon, because the crisis only lands if you felt what it
displaced. A friend sends a link. She reads the article. She comes back to a feed that is no
longer the same place — and the posts keep arriving while she is still reading it.

## How the motion is real

The device apps have no polling and no Supabase realtime; they update only when the server
broadcasts over Socket.IO from inside an API route. A direct database insert shows nothing on
an open page. So anything that must arrive on camera goes through the product’s own path:

| Behaviour | Path |
| --- | --- |
| NPC post lands in an open feed | `POST /api/injects/:id/publish` (delivery_config.app = social_feed) |
| Email lands in an open inbox | the same, app = email |
| DM lands in an open thread | `POST /api/social/messenger/send` |
| Comment lands under a post | `POST /api/social/posts` with `reply_to_post_id` |
| Counters climb | `POST /api/social/posts/:id/like` + the 30s engine tick |

Only the pre-crisis dressing is inserted directly, because the page loads after it.

Open on the environment itself. A wallpaper, app icons, a taskbar, a clock — this establishes in three seconds that the simulated world is a place you work in, not a screen you are shown.

   - _Real pointer motion, arrow cursor in its normal style._

**Farah Iskandar — Fakebook window · fakebook · 13s continuous**

## Act 4 — Fighting back

_Read it, prove it false, report it, get it retracted._  
4 sequences · 56s

### SEQ 13 — Reading for the lie

**Grace Lim Hui Ling — desktop · fakebook · 9s continuous**

Countering misinformation is not a button, it is reading. Show the work: someone going through the feed line by line, deciding what is merely angry and what is actually false.

_Sound: Clock only. Tight, procedural._

1. **Working the feed** (guided cursor, 6s) — She scrolls slowly, pointer tracking the claims one at a time.
   - _readAlong() across each post body, paired with a slow scroll._
2. **That one is false** (still — earned, 3s) — She stops on the frozen-assistance claim. It is not opinion, it is a checkable fact.

### SEQ 14 — Report it

**Grace Lim Hui Ling — desktop · fakebook · 16s continuous**

The platform-moderation lever, used properly: the right category, and a reason that cites what is actually false.

1. **Open the report** (control pressed, 3s) — The three-dot menu on the post. The report sheet slides in.
   - _Click button[title="Report post"] scoped inside the post._
2. **Misinformation** (control pressed, 3s) — She picks the category. The option lights blue.
   - _Click [data-testid="report-option-misinformation"]._
3. **Cite the fact** (live typing, 7s) — She types the reason live — no freeze notice exists, and here is the reference.
4. **Submit** (UI responds, 3s) — The sheet closes and the post’s report icon turns amber. It is on record.
   - _Click [data-testid="report-submit"], then frame the amber icon on the post._

### SEQ 15 — Take the article down

**Grace Lim Hui Ling — News window · news · 22s continuous**

The bigger lever. A social post is noise; a published article is the thing everyone else cites. Filing a formal correction request against it is the most consequential action in the film.

1. **Minimise, open News** (app transition, 4s) — Fakebook collapses to the taskbar; she double-clicks News on the desktop.
   - _window-minimize-facebook, then desktop-icon-news._
2. **The false article** (scroll, 4s) — The Independent Ledger piece repeating the frozen-assistance claim.
3. **Request correction** (control pressed, 3s) — The “Dispute / Request Correction” button. A takedown sheet opens.
   - _Click [data-testid="news-dispute-open"]._
4. **File the claim** (live typing, 8s) — She types the false claim and the verified facts that counter it.
5. **Filed** (UI responds, 3s) — “Dispute filed — under review.” It goes to adjudication against the fact sheet.
   - _Click [data-testid="dispute-submit"]; frame the green status line._

### SEQ 16 — It works

**Grace Lim Hui Ling — News window · news · 9s continuous**

Payoff for the procedure. Doing it properly actually removes the lie from the world — which is the argument for training people to do it properly.

_Sound: One clean resolving chord._

1. **Retracted** (arrives live, 5s) — The article reloads with a red banner across it. The claim is gone.
   - _The adjudicator upholds it and broadcasts news_article.updated; the open window swaps live._
2. **And it propagates** (UI responds, 4s) — Back on Fakebook, the posts that shared that article have vanished from the feed.
   - _Retraction sets platform_removed on shared posts and broadcasts social_post.removed._
